clips.title: The story
paras: Stone Tokens is a Horde assignment issued by Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill to retrieve magical binding artifacts from Dalaran agents in the Alterac region. The Forsaken seek to study the arcane methods Dalaran's mages use to enslave and command powerful elementals. Gathering these inert tokens serves as the foundation for the Magus's research into elemental subjugation.

The magi of Dalaran have long possessed a formidable command over elemental entities, using specialized conduits and enchanted foci to bind creatures from other dimensions into servitude. While the city itself is still rebuilding, its agents and remnant forces patrol the surrounding territory, relying on elementals as laborers and defensive shock troops. Magus Voidglare, an arcane researcher working on behalf of the Forsaken in Tarren Mill, seeks to dissect the precise sorcery Dalaran uses to compel these entities into obedience.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A notable talent of the wizards of Dalaran is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions. The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals. Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.
Enter the territories of the Dalaran wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.
You might find the tokens on any citizen of Dalaran, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp. It's safer than Dalaran itself.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, friend? The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These will do nicely. Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.
